plans.name: Sandbox
plans.tagline: Build and test your integration with the Growth feature set and test data.
plans.audience: Developers and product teams evaluating Ontiver
highlights: Simulated NIN, BVN, document and face-match results
Workflows, risk rules and reusable proofs to try
Sandbox API keys, webhooks and SDKs

plans.name: Launch
plans.tagline: Go live with real identity checks at pilot volume.
plans.audience: Early production pilots and small compliance teams
highlights: Production API keys and live checks

plans.name: Growth
plans.tagline: Scale onboarding with reusable proofs, risk rules and AML screening.
plans.audience: Fintechs, lenders and marketplaces scaling onboarding

plans.name: Compliance
plans.tagline: Audit-ready verification with monitoring, reports and dual control.
plans.audience: Regulated teams that answer to auditors and regulators
plans.support: Priority support with a named compliance contact
highlights: Compliance reports and signed audit exports
Dual control for keys, webhooks and data access

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.tagline: Custom volume, contracts and controls for high-volume programmes.
plans.audience: Banks, telcos and platforms with custom requirements
plans.support: Dedicated account manager and 24/7 incident line
plans.onboarding: Dedicated onboarding, security review and custom workflows

features.label: Production API and live checks
features.description: Run real NIN, BVN, document and biometric checks with production keys.

features.label: Identity checks
features.description: NIN, BVN, passport, driver's licence and voter's card verification with document and face match.

features.label: Verified contact proof
features.description: Email ownership proofs your customers can reuse.

features.label: Verification workflows
features.description: Consent-first onboarding cases with templates, steps and reviewer queues.

features.label: Webhooks and request logs
features.description: Signed webhooks, delivery retries and API request logs.

features.label: Risk policies and rules
features.description: Configure verification policies, risk thresholds and duplicate-identity signals.

features.label: Reusable proofs and customer registry
features.description: Accept proofs customers already hold and manage the issued-proof registry.

features.label: AML screening
features.description: Sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening.

features.label: Ongoing AML monitoring
features.description: Continuous re-screening of monitored customer profiles.

features.label: Compliance reports and signed audit exports
features.description: Generate regulator-ready reports and export signed audit trails.

features.label: Dual control approvals
features.description: Require a second approver for API keys, webhooks and sensitive data access.
